fixed_infrastructure.measurement_scope: Kafka -> Bronze -> Silver and DLQ; Gold excluded

result_metrics.kafka_lag_definition: For each sample, sum(max(0, Kafka high/latest offset - Spark Kafka source end offset)) across the run topic partitions.
result_metrics.latency_definition: Bronze spark_processing_time minus simulator ingestion_time, measured for every Bronze message after the stream drains. Historical event_time is not used. This is not Silver completion latency.
result_metrics.replay_to_bronze_latency_definition: Bronze spark_processing_time minus simulator ingestion_time, measured for every Bronze message after the stream drains. Historical event_time is not used. This is not Silver completion latency.

replay_to_bronze_latency_ms.definition: Bronze spark_processing_time minus simulator ingestion_time, measured for every Bronze message after the stream drains. Historical event_time is not used. This is not Silver completion latency.

warmup_policy.name: elapsed_time_and_completed_batches
warmup_policy.steady_state_end_rule: Simulator generation_end_time; post-replay drain is excluded.
warmup_policy.steady_state_start_rule: Later of warmup_start plus minimum_warmup_seconds, the minimum completed-batch cutoff for each main query, and replay start.

saturation_definition.sustainable: all expected records reach Bronze and Silver, final Kafka-to-Bronze source lag is zero, and both stream applications exit normally

throughput_baseline.measurement_scope: Kafka -> Bronze -> Silver and DLQ; Gold excluded
